title: Pong
summary: A single FSM with push$/pop$ pause. The scene watches state, the machine owns every transition — the engine-integration pattern at its purest.
teaches: Core FSM · enter/exit · domain variables · the engine-integration pattern
controls: W/S or ↑/↓ move · SPACE serve/replay · P pause

machines.title: Pong
machines.blurb: The whole game in one machine. Attract zeroes the scoreboards, Serving waits for the player to launch, InPlay tracks the rally, PointScored decides next-server (or game over), and GameOver waits for restart. Pause is push$/pop$ from either Serving or InPlay, so resume returns to whichever was active. The Phaser scene reads get_state() each frame and fires the interface events — the machine owns every transition.
